(4 marks)","q_type":"difference","marks":4,"blocks":[{"type":"compare_table","headers":["Distance","Displacement"],"rows":[["It is the actual path length covered by a body.","It is the shortest straight line distance between start and end points."],["It is always positive, never zero if the body moves.","It can be zero even if the body moves, if it returns to the start."],["It has no direction, only magnitude.","It has both magnitude and direction."],["Its value is always equal to or greater than displacement.","Its value is always equal to or less than distance."]]}],"keywords":["actual path length","shortest straight line distance","no direction","magnitude and direction"],"diagram":{"template":"path_vs_straight","params":{"path_length":10,"straight_length":6,"unit":"m"}},"unit_direction_note":"దూరం (Distance) కి దిశ ఉండదు, స్థానభ్రంశం (Displacement) కి దిశ ఉంటుంది.","concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","scene_prompt":"A child walks around a curved garden path from a bench to a tree while a straight dotted line connects the two points."}]}
